title: Lyon 2021 layout-metrics harness (#P, dmean, dmax, MSJavg)
description: Once PATCH-73 emits the conforming QuadLayout, instrument the verification harness with the four metrics from Lyon Table 1: (1) #P = patch count, (2) dmean = area-weighted mean angular deviation between layout arcs and the seamless param's iso-lines (degrees), (3) dmax = max deviation, (4) MSJavg = average minimum scaled Jacobian over the visualization quads. Implementation: each layout arc is a polyline of param-space points; per arc compute its tangent direction and compare against the seamless cardinal direction (atan2 difference, mod π/2). Aggregate area-weighted by the param-arclength of each arc segment. MSJavg requires the LCBK19 dense-quad pass (deferred to PATCH-75); for now skip MSJavg or report N/A.
definition-of-done: Add LyonMetrics utility + unit test on a known-good toy fixture (square patch, separatrices aligned with axes → dmean=0). Add a 'paper-comparison' optional test that loads ROCKERARM (when available) and prints Table-1-style row to stdout.
testing-plan: Toy: axis-aligned 2x2 layout → dmean=0°, dmax=0°. Hand-30k: report dmean/dmax in regression test stdout. Long-term gate: dmean < α + 1°.
